structured.feedback: The description is about 210 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, mostly active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the product details and reviews, and it leaves out weaknesses, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the "designed to absorb" passive phrasing and the blurred line between features and benefits.
